description: Dated record of every change to the data this server sells: rule flips, label fixes, duplicate removals, band versions, sample notices, each with the date, the tools affected and the count. Optional tool name to filter, and limit

limit.description: Number of entries, whole number 1 to 500, default 100. Example: 20

tool.description: Name of one tool of this server, lower case letters and underscores, up to 64 characters; absent = every entry

name: data_changelog
